summary: Most of the requested design/styling refresh appears implemented across Home, Post Detail, navigation, and footer (typography/spacing updates, new Home header/tagline, mobile-accessible nav, refined MediaGallery spacing, and an English-only footer). However, the diff also introduces a new Admin capability/mutation to update a post timestamp, which goes beyond styling-only scope and may imply backend/query behavior changes.

hallucinated_features.description: Added an Admin action/mutation to update a post's timestamp (“update post timestamps” / calendar icon button) which is a behavior/product change rather than design-only styling.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly constrains this change to design/styling only and disallows new product features or backend/data behavior changes; updating timestamps is not requested in REQ-20–REQ-24.
